title: SCP Additions
description: SCP Additions introduces SCPs and SCP-related items and features inspired by SCP Unity.
body:
![logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b9d834bc5afc41d56f44146c8c8521d6170d723c_0.webp)
---
SCP Additions is a mod focused on expanding Minecraft with SCP Foundation blocks, items, hazards, and facility-building tools. It includes keycards, Tesla Gates, SCP objects, and several mechanics designed for SCP facilities, heavily inspired by SCP: Containment Breach and SCP Unity.

## Requirements

### Required

- **Minecraft 1.20.1**
- **Forge 47.4.10 or newer**
- **[GeckoLib 4.4.9](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib) or newer**

### Optional

- **[Kleiders Custom Renderer API](https://modrinth.com/mod/kleiders-custom-renderer-api)**  
  Used to render custom player skins selected by SCP-914 on the **1:1** setting.

- **[MoreMcmeta Emissive Textures](https://modrinth.com/mod/moremcmeta-emissive)**  
  Enables emissive overlays for glowing block textures. The MoreMcmeta base dependency required by the plugin must also be installed.
---
<details>
<summary>
Gameplay Features
</summary>

## Inventory

SCP Additions includes a complete Survival Horror inventory interface inspired by SCP Unity with multiple specialized storage categories.

![Inventory](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5111fa210e13cf68f8c6ba5872024d74b67c3eda.jpeg)

## Status and Codex

The custom interface also includes **Status** and **Codex** panels.

![Status](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f1aac92d4c575426aca6a35a19218fdc90a23838.jpeg)

The Status panel presents information connected to the mod's survival systems, while the Codex can display configurable documents with custom images and texts.
While the Codex is working, it's a bit too technical right now, so I'll update it in the future to be more user friendly.

## Contextual Interactions

SCP Additions includes a contextual interaction system for blocks and entities.

![Prompt](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dd77041ddbffbedb7abf6849b5e975136277f9f8.jpeg)

Configured objects can display SCP Unity-styled prompts, icons, and other conditions.

Dropped items display a pickup prompt by default.

![Pickup](https://i.imgur.com/T5Tb7Xh.gif)

The default interaction list is stored in:

```text
config/scpinventory/context_interactions.json
```

The file can be edited to add, remove, or customize supported interactions.

Also, pressing K on the keyboard and looking to a block/entity in the world brings a configuration GUI with a visual display for the interaction icon anchor. The key can also be used hovering over an item in the inventory to configure its type and behavior.

## Custom Health and Stamina

The mod includes custom health and stamina HUDs based on SCP Unity.

![HUD](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7bc99924da2a5e482a069da1698a34df702f9a3f.jpeg)

There's also new walking and running speeds that matches the Survival Horror style more. Walking is slower while sprinting is slightly faster.

## Blink System

Players need to blink when nearby SCP-173

![blink](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0e864d91bd4b2d003c34284fa8e2fbb8ad1a7067.jpeg)

The blink system includes:

- Automatic blinking;
- A manual hold-to-blink keybind;
- A blink meter;
- The **Eye Sore** effect, which accelerates blink drain;
- Integration with SCP-173 observation behavior.

---
All gameplay features can be disabled individually on:
```text
config/scpadditions/modules.json
```

</details>

Facility Features

## SCP Unity-Inspired Building Set

Version 3.0 introduces a large collection of SCP Unity-inspired facility blocks and decoration.

![Facility](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/051f09e476052c507bf231b0e004a941ba5db25b.jpeg)

## Facility Doors

SCP Additions includes multiple animated doors inspired by SCP Unity.

![Door](https://i.imgur.com/s7cO6bs.gif)

## Tesla Gate

Tesla Gates are high-voltage security barriers designed for containment zones, checkpoints, restricted corridors, etc.

Active Tesla Gates will detect nearby entities and deliver a lethal electric discharge.

![Tesla Gate Demo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ffaa6e57d5fb2e983305e91ce1d1d456cae4fefa.gif)

## Tesla Gate Terminal

The Tesla Gate Terminal gives centralized control over Tesla Gates.

Using **Security Credentials**, authorized personnel can access the terminal interface and control the global Tesla Gate system. The terminal allows Tesla Gates to be enabled or disabled and includes an **Emergency Override** mode for more aggressive containment behavior.

Features include:

- SCP Unity-inspired terminal interface;
- Security Credential authentication;
- Global Tesla Gate on/off control;
- Emergency Override mode.

![Tesla Gate Security Terminal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e01d2c9933b37373727599675864c14b95fb7e87.jpeg)
![Tesla Gate Terminal GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a16c50dd4fd1479734d305d578f84ba73a18b27b.png)![Tesla Gate Terminal GUI Credentials](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8d9d976793aac5121913772ea41676f1d387dce5.png)![Tesla Gate Terminal GUI Override](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7f22725de25ec448c515b0468371e2d7c2c7aabe.png)
![Terminal demo](https://i.imgur.com/rHXrOLV.gif)

## Keycards

SCP Additions includes six keycard clearance levels with colors based on the [Anomaly Classification System](https://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/anomaly-classification-system-guide):

![Level 1 Keycard](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/244a73bb0db16b88b94f988199f179d87f843620.png) **Level 1 Keycard:** Unrestricted (UR)
 
![Level 2 Keycard](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/015b264fd8deb350ebadca18eed218ba37662077.png) **Level 2 Keycard:** Restricted (RS) 

![Level 3 Keycard](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ac813c67033059af5674abf32312931b445dac6a.png) **Level 3 Keycard:** Confidential (CF) 

![Level 4 Keycard](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/63b9cfbb45b940eb16ded9518319cc1ef47a5935.png) **Level 4 Keycard:** Secret (SC) 

![Level 5 Keycard](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1a499d4fa11be662ce4224c6d7164b4186b2133d.png) **Level 5 Keycard:** Top Secret (TS) 

![Level 6 Keycard](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/80b3fdd0f66e7c456dc5208ee11875b74a9fcb5f.png) **Level 6 Keycard:** Cosmic Top Secret (CTS)

Higher-level keycards can access their own level and all lower-level readers.

## Keycard Readers

Keycard Readers allow access control for facility doors and restricted areas.

Readers can be placed on either side of a wall or doorway. When a valid keycard is presented, the reader temporarily grants access.

![Keycard Reader](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e49ee87d49a386b63c2c65ead52c21ceae2bb04d_0.webp)

Readers can also be configured using the **Screwdriver**.

![Screwdriver](https://i.imgur.com/PS9r6Hl.gif)

## Buttons

Buttons function similarly to Keycard Readers, but do not require clearance.

Button panels can synchronize with an existing opposite panel.

![Buttons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/306796766e309a79a5d33cfefae4018fa94ed14f.jpeg)

## Decontamination Checkpoint

The Decontamination Checkpoint removes active effects from players who pass through it.

![Decon Checkpoint](https://i.imgur.com/LMCBc4U.gif)

It can also optionally save the player’s spawn point when used, depending on the gamerule:

```
/gamerule deconCheckpoint true
```

This gamerule is disabled by default.

<summary>
Featured SCPs
</summary>

## SCP-079

SCP-079 is a sentient artificial intelligence that can interact with facility systems when given access to System Control.

When given the System Control, it will be able to interact with doors connected to buttons or keycard readers. It may use it to trap players in dangerous situations, such as when running from a threat, close doors that the player is heading to, and even open doors for other threats, making your map traversal harder.

![SCP-079](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/33c4eabe94bea9b112ecea362c906b871d48de61_0.webp)

## SCP-131-A and SCP-131-B <small><small>(By Lt Masipag)</small></small>

SCP-131-A and SCP-131-B are friendly entities that may _look_ out for you.

They include:

- Idle voice sounds;
- SCP-styled interaction notices;
- The ability to observe SCP-173.

![SCP-131](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1728c75e5be1fb6c08d6856afea58db71c01aad9.jpeg)

![SCP-131 follow](https://i.imgur.com/nK2eRDQ.gif)

## SCP-173 <small><small>(By Moto42)</small></small>

SCP-173 is a fully hostile entity built around observation and paranoia.

![SCP-173](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/69aab10949892ad489c5499ab17525c8b2c6ad68.jpeg)

Its behavior includes:

- Complete custom random natural spawn chance (a little bit more complicated than vanilla mobs);
- Line-of-sight checks that distinguish obstructing and transparent blocks;
- Complete immobility while observed;
- Immediate movement reevaluation when observers blink, close their eyes, or lose line of sight;
- Fast snap movement when unobserved;
- Direct pursuit, pathfinding fallback, and side-step fallback behavior.

SCP-173 also interacts directly with the custom blink system and with SCP-131.

![173 Encounter](https://i.imgur.com/NYmBIJp.gif)

![SCP-131 stare contest](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5807c4a7c8af8b7d52bfa9db0ba2f0ab2391d02f.jpeg)

## SCP-294 <small><small>(By Agent Jackrabbit)</small></small>

SCP-294 is a strange coffee machine capable of dispensing far more than ordinary coffee.

Enter a drink request into its custom interface and see what the machine produces. SCP-294 uses a configurable JSON-based drink system, allowing drink aliases, colors, effects, sounds, custom actions, and special outcomes to be adjusted through config files.

The default drink list can be edited in:

```text
config/scpadditions/294drinks.json
```

![SCP-294](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d729e434f56a5eb4eb9b013915c34489d005a91a_0.webp)
![SCP-294 demo](https://i.imgur.com/EqixeJJ.gif)

## SCP-330 <small><small>(By DrKondraki)</small></small>

SCP-330 is a small bowl of candy marked with a simple warning:

**"Take no more than two, please!"**

Players can take four types of candy, each with its own effect. Taking more than two candies will have severe consequences. 

Candy types include:

* ![Red Candy](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aa64c61619f2508f2fc9d8f165f2152d0ba3a5d3.png) **Red Candy:** Regeneration;
* ![Green Candy](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f45dc7d99b870e6061b6e46e0e776b3255ef2267.png) **Green Candy:** Night Vision;
* ![Yellow Candy](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4e5dad703542f7acc397f8cdf4bfef00609c1281.png) **Yellow Candy:** Jump Boost;
* ![Blue Candy](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1912d4b2ee1146dfe4fa0c519c80283f5bd9e312.png) **Blue Candy:** Speed.

If a player tries to take more than allowed, the extra candy will vanish.

![SCP-330](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2da249b9212480bd32d70f4951f0807f48f4b67d_0.webp)

## SCP-426 <small><small>(By Flah)</small></small>

Hello! I am a toaster, and I affect how players perceive and describe me. Players who interact with me may begin referring to me in the first person.

![scp-426](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/63b7bd47226972e1fa81d78f8d994223e6d10d3f_0.webp)

## SCP-572 <small><small>(By DrClef)</small></small>

SCP-572 is a sword that gives its wielder an overwhelming sense of strength, confidence, and invincibility.

Unfortunately, the confidence it provides is much more impressive than the weapon itself.

![SCP-572](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/90815d98efd1a3ac661e9a071d9a8cb254696ade_0.webp)

## SCP-902 <small><small>(By DrEverettMann)</small></small>

SCP-902 is a mysterious closed box.

What is inside?

There must be something...

![SCP-902](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c1c17f5efc89c0889c2b25a62f2f79cfeadb1528_0.webp)

## SCP-914 <small><small>(By Dr Gears)</small></small>

SCP-914 is the clockwork machine, capable of refining items and entities through five settings:

* Rough;
* Coarse;
* 1:1;
* Fine;
* Very Fine.

SCP-914 has a custom interface with a draggable dial and a configurable recipe system. Recipes can be edited or expanded through JSON files, allowing custom item transformations, entity transformations, weighted outputs, chances, and machine behavior.

SCP-914 can be found in the world as a rare structure, or placed using the **SCP-914 Assembly Kit**.

Config files are located in:

```text
config/scpadditions/914recipes.json
config/scpadditions/914recipes.d/
```

Features include:

* Custom SCP-914 GUI;
* Draggable setting dial;
* Item refinement;
* Entity (and player) refinement;
* Weighted outputs;
* NBT copying;
* Configurable machine offsets and timing;
* Runtime recipe fragments;
* SCP-914 Assembly Kit for placing the full machine structure.

The SCP-914 Assembly Kit places the full SCP-914 structure from a saved structure file.

![SCP-914](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2cdd965200feddae3bacbc0ee932ca7cb9c238be.jpeg)
![SCP-914 demo](https://i.imgur.com/rWEeOa3.gif)

## SCP-1176 <small><small>(By Smapti)</small></small>

SCP-1176 adds the Mellified Man and its related honey mechanics.

Players can obtain special honey connected to SCP-1176, interact with the sarcophagus, and experience effects based on the mod’s blood type system.

![SCP-1176](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f4a3e509abf0a74afc613f983e751dcb58524083_0.webp)

## Blood Type System

Players have a blood type that can be viewed from the inventory overlay.

Blood type changes on respawn and is currently used by SCP-1176-related mechanics.

![Blood Type](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/97286c97bceec8a9ea27e97ba7120a62fe800c60_0.webp)
